comment: The trigger outputs are not 1ms pulses: calendar.cpp:132 sets 10V while the unit's progress is below 0.01, so the pulse is a hundredth of the unit and lasts from 10ms on the second to about three and a half days on the year. The stepped ramps use the subdivision table at calendar.cpp:25, {4, 60, 24, 7, 4, 12, 3, 12} for second through year; the readme's table lists 60 for the hour, 24 for the day, 7 for the week and 4 for the month, which is the code's list shifted by one row. The season ramp divides by a fixed 90 days (calendar.cpp:118) while summing the real lengths of the months elapsed, so a 92-day season passes 10V before it ends, and the year ramp divides by 365 days (calendar.cpp:121), so it passes 10V on the last day of a leap year. Local time is re-read once a second (calendar.cpp:85); UTC is re-read every sample.
